output.answer: Target's latest annual report is its 2025 Annual Report — the Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, which was filed with the SEC on March 11, 2026 (SEC accession no. 0000027419-26-000016). You can read or download it from Target's corporate investor-relations site at corporate.target.com/investors/annual/2025-annual-report (with a direct "Download Report" link), or from the SEC's EDGAR database, where the main document is tgt-20260131.htm under the filing index for accession 0000027419-26-000016. The same filing can also be reached by searching EDGAR for Target Corporation (CIK 0000027419) and filtering for Form 10-K, where Target's annual-report archive is also maintained on its investor site.
caveats: Target labels the report its "2025 Annual Report" even though it covers the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 (Target's fiscal years end near the start of the calendar year), so the fiscal-year label differs from the calendar year it mostly covers.

If a newer Form 10-K (fiscal year ending late January 2027) is filed after March 2027, it will supersede this one as the latest annual report; as of November 2026 the fiscal-2025 10-K is the most recent.
The corporate-site "Download Report" page is a PDF/HTML download landing page; if the download link changes, the SEC EDGAR copy of the filing is the stable permanent record.
